CCI Various Post Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Cotton Corporation of India Limited (CCIL) has released the answer key for the Junior Commercial Executive, Junior Assistant & Assistant Manager Post. This recruitment was released for 148 posts. Applications for CCI Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 09 July 2024 to 24 July 2024. The written examination was held on 01 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their CCI Various Post Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 July 2026
  • Last Date : 24 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 19 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 03 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1700/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 590/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
